title: House Ways and Means Committee publishes crypto tax bill ahead of hearing this week
dek: The House Ways and Means Committee published a crypto tax bill addressing de minimis transactions, staking, and other industry-requested policies. A hearing on the proposal is scheduled for later this week.
author: Crypto Cronkite
key_fact: Legislative consideration of crypto tax treatment is moving through a key revenue committee with a formal bill and hearing this week, signaling active engagement on compliance and taxation rules.
bottom_line: The hearing this week is the next inflection point. If the committee moves the bill to markup, it signals momentum; if testimony surfaces technical or political objections, the de minimis and staking provisions could face revision. The outcome shapes what compliance requirements hit the retail market next.
body: The House Ways and Means Committee published a crypto tax bill addressing de minimis transactions, staking, and other industry-requested policies, according to CoinDesk's reporting on September 14. A hearing on the proposal is scheduled for later this week.
The bill's treatment of de minimis transactions and staking income represents the first formal legislative text from a key revenue committee on long-standing industry compliance requests.
